knownObservation.detail: The network log shows HTTP 503 immediately before the 200 on the landing endpoint.
knownObservation.cause: React StrictMode double-invokes the effect in development; the first request is aborted by the cleanup and surfaces through the Vite proxy as 503.
knownObservation.handling: The stale-response guard in App.tsx discards it. The rendered result is the 200.
